name: Earth
description: Our home planet and the only known world to support life.
fact: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water.

name: Mars
description: A cold, rocky world known for its reddish surface.
fact: Mars has the largest volcano known in the Solar System: Olympus Mons.

name: Jupiter
description: The largest planet in our Solar System, a giant made mostly of gas.
fact: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a giant storm.

name: Saturn
description: A gas giant famous for its spectacular rings.
fact: Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice particles and rocky debris.

name: The Moon
description: Earth's natural satellite, shaping our tides and night skies.
fact: The Moon is slowly moving away from Earth.

name: The Sun
description: The star at the centre of our Solar System.
fact: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.

name: Andromeda Galaxy
description: A neighbouring spiral galaxy approaching the Milky Way.
fact: Andromeda is the nearest large galaxy to the Milky Way.

name: Black Hole
description: A region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that light cannot escape.
fact: The boundary beyond which light cannot escape is called the event horizon.
